item.title: Grail’s multi-cancer early detection test misses study goal
item.description: Shares in the company lost about half their value in Friday trading after use of the test wasn’t associated with a statistically significant reduction in late-stage cancer diagnoses.

item.title: Small and mighty: single-domain antibodies pack a biological punch
item.description: VHH antibodies: they’re not just small, they're modular engineering platforms, capable of powerful biological activity. But with great power comes great challenges!

item.title: Gilead to buy Arcellx in $7.8B wager on multiple myeloma cell therapy
item.description: The acquisition bolsters Gilead’s sputtering cell therapy business with a medication the company expects to become a “foundational treatment” for the blood cancer, its CEO said.

item.title: Merck to split cancer, specialty drug businesses in leadership shakeup
item.description: Ahead of the looming loss of Keytruda’s exclusivity, the company is creating a standalone, cancer-focused unit and a second business housing its other drugs and vaccines.

item.title: Novo’s next-gen obesity shot fails to match Lilly drug in head-to-head study
item.description: Shares fell by more than 15% on results showing study participants receiving Novo’s CagriSema lost less weight than those who took Lilly’s Zepbound.

item.title: FDA fleshes out new roadmap for testing personalized therapies
item.description: At an event on Monday, the agency officially unveiled long-awaited draft guidance meant to help speed the development of bespoke treatments for extremely rare diseases.

item.title: Slate starts up with $130M and a headache drug from China
item.description: The biotech is developing a drug aimed at a protein called PACAP, which has emerged as a potentially new way to prevent the onset of migraines.

item.title: Novo, searching for a spark, spotlights new data for three-pronged obesity drug
item.description: Novo’s answer to a closely watched Lilly drug spurred roughly 20% weight loss after 24 weeks in a Phase 2 trial, results one of its executives claimed to be “differentiating.”

item.title: Novo to cut GLP-1 drug prices; Palvella soars on study data
item.description: Wegovy and Ozempic’s list prices will be reduced by as much as 50% effective next year. Elsewhere, Palvella’s market value surged past $1 billion while Pfizer nabbed rights to another obesity drug.

item.title: Vir climbs on Astellas deal, study results for ‘masked’ T cell engager
item.description: According to one analyst, the alliance and early data “validate” the oncology work of Vir, which was once purely an infectious disease specialist before changing course.
